external_prior.rule: Do not reinterpret abstractive generation token limits as an extractive word cap.

dev_iqr_band_500_650.role: floor-bearing control analogous to the historical Multi-News band

paper_mean_cap_550.role: rounded paper-reported full-dataset mean; external pre-score prior

rounding_rule: Round distribution-derived word caps to the nearest ten words; Python half-to-even does not affect the observed values.
cheap_methods: lexical-only provenance-aware deterministic Greedy with length_normalized importance

selection_rule.dev: Run all four protocols and all three methods; rank by the mean across methods of per-document macro mean(ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, ROUGE-Lsum).
selection_rule.dev_test: Evaluate every still-valid protocol exactly once on the 292 frozen dev-test IDs. Select the highest mean cross-method macro ROUGE only if paired 95% bootstrap differences versus every alternative exclude zero after Holm correction.
selection_rule.tie: If no protocol has a multiplicity-corrected advantage, freeze median_cap_570 because GovReport has no historical extractive word ceiling and this is the simplest no-floor contract aligned to frozen development references.
selection_rule.rejection: Reject row loss, schema drift, upper-budget violation, or denominator changes. Source-intrinsic minimum shortfall is recorded under the already-frozen F-17 policy; no other fail-loud relaxation is permitted.

parent_underspecification_resolution: The parent preregistration allowed a historical official cap if one existed but did not state the fallback when none exists. This addendum resolves that gap before system scores: use the paper mean as the external-prior candidate and the frozen dev median as the tie winner.
